student_passage:
The school asked 50 Grade Eight students which problems they had during the school week. Each student could choose several different problems from the list, but could choose each problem only once. The chart shows the results. The number below each bar matches a problem number in the list. The height of a bar shows how many students chose that problem. Its top label shows the percentage of all 50 students.

1. Keeping a tidy desk
2. Understanding new words
3. Remembering homework dates
4. Reading long instructions
5. Choosing a study partner
6. Concentrating in a noisy room
7. Packing the right books
8. Finding online information
9. Checking written work
10. Planning revision time
11. Asking for help

图表文字替代：纵轴Students，0至50，每10人一格；横轴Problem number，1—11依次对应上表。各柱顶百分标签依次为32%、56%、24%、40%、16%、36%、20%、12%、28%、48%、8%。各比例均以同50人为分母，允许一人选不同问题。
